fields.label: Bundle ID
fields.help: The bundle ID to use for the distribution.

fields.label: Certificate Name
fields.help: The name of the SSL/TLS certificate attached to the distribution, if any.

fields.label: IP Address Type
fields.help: The IP address type of the distribution.

fields.label: Is Enabled
fields.help: Indicates whether the distribution is enabled.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the distribution.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: Cache Behavior
Behavior
fields.help: The cache behavior for the specified path.

fields.label: Path
fields.help: The path to a directory or file to cached, or not cache.
An array of objects that describe the per-path cache behavior of the distribution.

fields.label: Cache Behavior Settings
Allowed Http Methods
fields.help: The HTTP methods that are processed and forwarded to the distribution's origin.

fields.label: Cached Http Methods
fields.help: The HTTP method responses that are cached by your distribution.

fields.label: Default Ttl
fields.help: The default amount of time that objects stay in the distribution's cache before the distribution forwards another request to the origin to determine whether the content has been updated.

fields.label: Maximum Ttl
fields.help: The maximum amount of time that objects stay in the distribution's cache before the distribution forwards another request to the origin to determine whether the object has been updated.

fields.label: Minimum Ttl
fields.help: The minimum amount of time that objects stay in the distribution's cache before the distribution forwards another request to the origin to determine whether the object has been updated.

fields.label: Forwarded Cookies
Cookies Allow List
fields.help: The specific cookies to forward to your distribution's origin.

fields.label: Option
fields.help: Specifies which cookies to forward to the distribution's origin for a cache behavior: all, none, or allow-list to forward only the cookies specified in the cookiesAllowList parameter.
An object that describes the cookies that are forwarded to the origin.

fields.label: Forwarded Headers
Headers Allow List
fields.help: The specific headers to forward to your distribution's origin.

fields.label: Option
fields.help: The headers that you want your distribution to forward to your origin and base caching on.
An object that describes the headers that are forwarded to the origin.

fields.label: Forwarded Query Strings
Option
fields.help: Indicates whether the distribution forwards and caches based on query strings.

fields.label: Query Strings Allowed List
fields.help: The specific query strings that the distribution forwards to the origin.
An object that describes the query strings that are forwarded to the origin.
An object that describes the cache behavior settings of the distribution.

fields.label: Default Cache Behavior
Behavior
fields.help: The cache behavior of the distribution.
An object that describes the default cache behavior of the distribution.

fields.label: Origin
Name
fields.help: The name of the origin resource.

fields.label: Protocol Policy
fields.help: The protocol that your Amazon Lightsail distribution uses when establishing a connection with your origin to pull content.

fields.label: Region Name
fields.help: The AWS Region name of the origin resource.
An object that describes the origin resource of the distribution, such as a Lightsail instance, bucket, or load balancer.
